## Publication Information

**Date:** 1789

**Imprint:** London: Newbery

**Notes:** The second edition had illustrations by John Bewick, brother of the famous engraver Thomas Bewick.  The story was Included by CMY in the second <i>[Storehouse of Stories](../cmy_books/cmybook_96.qmd)</i>.
